title: eludite/solution/configurations
description: The open solution's configurations and platforms, each project's mapping (Configuration Manager's grid), and the active selection (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"). `.sln`: `SolutionConfigurationPlatforms` and `ProjectConfigurationPlatforms` (`ActiveCfg`, `Build.0`, `Deploy.0`). `.slnx`: `<Configurations>` (`BuildType`, `Platform`; `Debug`, `Release` and `Any CPU` when it lists none) and each project's `<BuildType>`, `<Platform>`, `<Build>` and `<Deploy>` rules (`Solution="Release|*"`). A project file opened as the solution maps each of its configurations to itself.

params.description: No params: omitted, null, or an empty object/array.

path.description: The solution file; null when none is open.

format.description: Which file the mapping comes from.

configurations.description: The solution configurations, in the file's order.

platforms.description: The solution platforms, in the file's order (the first is the default).

projects.description: The solution's projects, in solution order.

selection.description: The active solution configuration and platform (eludite/solution/setConfiguration's `select`; the first configuration and platform until the shell selects).

path.description: Absolute path of the project file.

configurations.description: The project's own configurations, for the grid's lists.

platforms.description: The project's own platforms, for the grid's lists.

mappings.description: One per solution configuration and platform the project has a mapping for (a `.sln` without an `ActiveCfg` line for a pair has none: the project is skipped there).

mapping.description: One cell row of Configuration Manager: what a project builds in one solution configuration and platform.

configuration.description: The project configuration it maps to.

platform.description: The project platform it maps to (`Any CPU` as the solution file writes it).

build.description: Build checked: the project builds in this solution configuration. A project that does not is skipped, with Visual Studio's `Skipped Build` line in the Output window.
